name: authority-tier
title: Authority Tier
description: Source program authority tier (Decision 5 of strategy-source-program.md). Six tiers tracked in frontmatter on every source entry; constrains which sources may be cited as primary support for a claim.

values.label: Foundational Canon
values.description: The Raëlian corpus. Decision 1 locks this tier as Raëlian-exclusive. Highest within the project frame; no other tradition occupies it.

values.label: Primary Comparative
values.description: Hebrew Bible, Qur'an, Book of Mormon, ancient texts. High; the comparative witness layer.

values.label: Scholarly Context
values.description: Lexicons, philology, comparative religion academia. High for context, not for doctrinal weight.

values.label: Scientific Context
values.description: Astronomy, genetics, archaeology, origins-of-life. High for empirical claims.

values.label: Critical / Skeptical
values.description: Critiques of ancient-astronaut readings, skeptical scholarship. High; they keep the corpus honest.

values.label: Supplementary
values.description: Documentaries, lectures, encyclopedias, museum materials. Pedagogical only, never primary support for a claim.
